prompts.transport: Create a NEW Chinese petroleum engineering teaching infographic. Reference image is STYLE AND EXACT COMPOSITION reference only, not subject content. Match its warm ivory near-white background, delicate pastel miniature isometric 3D resin models, tiny full-body orange-uniform workers, navy Chinese sans-serif text on pastel rounded ribbons, smooth clean paint, soft shadows and airy low-contrast far landscape. EXACT canvas 1448 x 1086 (4:3). Preserve composition: upper full-width field/equipment scene y0-355, broad blue common-data ribbon y375-425, FIVE equally wide parallel open workstations x0-288,290-578,580-868,870-1158,1160-1448 y430-780 with tiny realistic equipment and people, colored ribbons merge into compact integrated records/results scene y825-1086. Every station header sits y435-475, short one-line caption y490-525, visual apparatus y540-770. All five headers clearly readable. Large breathing space. NO overall title. NO dark sepia poster, no dark brushwork, no thick panel borders, no portrait people, no decorative math, no performance claims. These five cases are parallel/optional tasks, NOT sequential steps. Use gentle branching and merging flow, don't connect stations as required serial process. Data sources in art are conceptual and no fake measured numbers. SUBJECT transportation of oil and gas. Upper scene: exposed cross-section buried long-distance pipeline with a clearly tiny leak plume on one segment, yellow guardrails at centrifugal pump station, separate gas compressor, two white oil storage tanks in a containment bund, flow meter, sensor posts, small control room. Oil moves in pipe from left to right, never into soil except one explicitly marked leak. Faint green hills. Four tiny upper pale-blue labels “管线监测”“泵站运行”“流量计量”“储罐巡检”. Common blue data ribbon flows into five stations. Station exact headers left to right: “T1 泄漏检测”, “T2 腐蚀评估”, “T3 集输优化”, “T4 计量校正”, “T5 储罐监控”. Their exact short captions: “压力与流量异常，定位泄漏线索”, “识别缺陷，跟踪壁厚变化”, “在压力与流量约束下调度”, “跟踪漂移，核对计量偏差”, “从图像读液位与异常候选”. T1 desk has pressure and acoustic waveform monitor and pipe with sensor. T2 has clean cutaway pipe, one rusty shallow pit, colorful inspection strip on monitor. T3 compact two pumps at different running states and optimization chart. T4 two small flow meters and offset curves on monitor. T5 miniature storage tank with visible translucent level strip, small inspection camera, tank image monitor. Plinth colors orange, sky-blue, lavender, sage-green, teal. Lower merge to ledger labeled “统一管段、设备与时间” with small unnumbered rows, and two orange workers at control screens labeled “异常候选 → 工程复核 → 运行记录”. Never illustrate human in pipeline.
